violations.description: A hardcoded credential/secret placeholder (consumer key secret, access token, and access token secret) is present in source code.
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credential templates and load them from environment variables or secure credential storage.

violations.description: Temporary/build/local files (.env, .pyc, .vscode/settings.json) are tracked in version control.
violations.evidence: 1 File handle/File handle binary/.env and compiled .pyc files tracked in git status
violations.recommendation: Add these paths to .gitignore and remove them from the repository using git rm --cached.
